chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hashimi told us, saying: Furat ibn Ibrahim al-Kufi told us, saying: He told me Muhammad ibn Hasan ibn Ibrahim, saying: Alwan ibn Muhammad told us, saying: Hannan ibn Sadir told us, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), saying:
The saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, in al-Hamd: 'The Path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor' means: Muhammad and his Progeny, Allah's blessings be upon them.

key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: Al-Hamd (The Praise), referring to Surah Al-Fatiha
key_terms.صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ: The Path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor (Quranic verse)

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'blessed ones' mentioned in Surah Al-Fatiha according to Shia interpretation?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) offers a specific exegetical interpretation of the 'Path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor' in Surah Al-Fatiha, identifying them as the Prophet Muhammad and his Progeny (Ahl al-Bayt). This highlights the Shia scholarly tradition of linking the ultimate spiritual guidance in the opening chapter of the Quran directly to the divine lineage, emphasizing their unique status as the exemplars of faith and the path to God's pleasure.
